entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... I'm calling about an order. I think I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Could I start with your name and order number?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. Order number 88-V-F-2091. I bought this new `jersey` and I've been a loyal customer for years... I just feel let down.

Thank you, Maria. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the Aero-Performance Jersey. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

It's the `wrong size`. I ordered my usual medium, but it's just `too tight` across the chest. I was really counting on it for a big charity ride, and I really needed this money if it wasn't going to work out. I don't know what to do.

I completely understand how frustrating that can be, especially when you're preparing for an important event. Let me just confirm the delivery date for you... okay, I see it was delivered 28 days ago.

I'm checking our policy for you now. One moment... Okay, I have good news. For a standard apparel item like this `jersey`, you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely get this sorted out for you.
Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. So I can send it back?

Yes, absolutely. We can either process a full refund to your original payment method, or we could set up an `exchange` for the next size up. And because you're a VIP member and we want to make sure you're ready for your charity ride, I can waive the return shipping fee and upgrade the shipping on your new size to our 2-day express at no charge.
Really? That would be wonderful! An `exchange` would be perfect. Thank you so much, David, that's a huge relief.

It's my pleasure, Maria. I've just initiated that `exchange` for you. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid return label in the next few minutes. Just send the original `jersey` back to us, and your new one will be on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you!
You're very welcome. We appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. Have a fantastic day and good luck on your ride!
